items.Sentence: The proposed MFRO Facility would be sized to produce 2 MGD of MFRO product water, which depending on agricultural demands, would be blended with a quantity of HARRF disinfected tertiary-treated recycled water to produce a final agricultural reuse supply
The increased recycled water use includes the addition of the proposed MFRO Facility. HARRF tertiary-treated recycled water will serve as the source of supply to the City's proposed MFRO Facility
